algorithm: each regime bar: raw = top1 label if (confidence>=min_confidence and p1-p2>=min_margin and status==OK) else UNKNOWN-candidate
if raw != current regime: candidate(raw) counter++ ; if counter>=confirm_bars and bars_in_current>=min_dwell: switch (candidate must equal raw on each of the confirm bars, else reset)
on switch: bars_in_current=0; failed candidates enter cooldown (label barred from candidacy for cooldown bars)
any error/LOCAL_INVALID -> treated as UNKNOWN-candidate (never auto-switch on errors)
output regime label per bar = persisted state
rationale_outcome_blind: chosen from regime semantics + synthetic fixtures: a 5-class probability vector needs a majority belief (0.50) separated from the runner-up (0.20 margin); 2-bar confirmation kills single-bar flapping; 6-bar dwell (BTC 6h / SPY 6 sessions) prevents whipsaw regime changes; 3-bar cooldown bars a rejected candidate from immediate re-candidacy. NO PnL was computed when choosing these numbers.
